summary: Tested Commission Alerts backend/API, real Resend sends, cron auth/idempotency/background behavior, profile/status persistence, alert bucket dedup/far-future/expired paths, schedule contract, Settings UI, and dashboard/journal/intake regressions. Desktop feature flows pass, but bucket selection is critically wrong below 60 days and the Settings alerts panel is inaccessible on mobile. Existing CORS and brute-force issues also remain.

critical.issue: ALERT_BUCKETS is iterated as [60,30,14,7,1,0], so every non-expired date at 60 days or less maps to bucket 60. At 30/14/7/1/0 days the cron still returns bucket 60 and, after the first 60-day alert, dedup skips all later required notices.
Brute-force lockout failed again through ingress: six invalid attempts returned 401 instead of the sixth returning 429 because request.client.host can vary across proxy requests.
Preflight returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and does not allow credentials; server.py ignores CORS_ORIGINS and hardcodes wildcard/no credentials while the frontend uses withCredentials=true.

ui_bugs.component: Responsive authenticated layout / Settings alerts panel
ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844 the fixed 256px sidebar and ml-64 main content place alerts-panel at x=296 with width=375; document width is 711px, so most Settings content and alert controls are off-screen.
Rendered text omits spaces around the cadence span ('at60 ... 1days').

issues: Commission Expiration uses the browser-native input[type=date] picker rather than the shared shadcn calendar component.
Recharts repeatedly logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings during initial render, indicating the responsive chart containers mount before receiving valid dimensions.

action_items: Fix _current_alert_bucket to choose the smallest qualifying threshold (for example iterate 0,1,7,14,30,60 or use min), then retest all 60/30/14/7/1/0 boundaries and sequential cron sends.
Reset last_alert_bucket/last-alert metadata when commission_expires changes to a renewed commission, otherwise a prior cycle's 60-day bucket can suppress the next cycle's 60-day notice.
Make cron webhook idempotency atomic with a unique cron_runs.run_id index and insert-once operation to prevent concurrent duplicate webhook deliveries from both enqueueing work.
Make the authenticated sidebar/main layout responsive so Settings and alerts controls fit within a 390px viewport without horizontal overflow.
Use explicit CORS_ORIGINS with credentials enabled and key brute-force limits to a stable trusted client identity/email behind ingress.
Add visible alert-status API error handling and revert the optimistic toggle if profile persistence fails.
Fix alert-description spacing and replace the native date picker with the shared calendar component.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1,015 lines and should be split into focused auth, alerts/cron, journal, intake, client, and PDF modules.
update_profile changes commission_expires without clearing last_alert_bucket, creating stale dedup state across renewals.
cron_runs uses find-then-insert without a unique index, so X-Webhook-Id idempotency is race-prone under concurrent delivery.
Settings.loadStatus silently swallows errors, and toggleAlerts does not roll back local state when persistence fails.
Status values such as days-left and upcoming-alert rows lack dedicated data-testid attributes despite being critical informational output.
The requested /app/auth_testing.md playbook is absent; direct cookie, bcrypt, lockout, CORS, and seed-password checks were performed instead.

success_rate.backend: 86% (19/22 unique scoped tests passed; Commission Alerts 6/7)
success_rate.frontend: 90% scoped (desktop Settings and regressions passed; mobile layout failed)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily changed and restored the admin commission/alert fields, paused and restored non-admin alert flags during cron tests, deleted TEST_COMMISSION_ cron-run records, and created/deleted temporary TEST_ intakes and a journal entry. Eight real test emails were sent to the admin across API/UI runs; no test database records remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop Settings passed: alerts panel/status list, toggle off/on persistence, preview POST with email_id and success toast, dashboard cards, journal PDF download, and intake page. Cron auth 401/401/200, immediate ack under 3s, sequential duplicate=true, +45 send bucket=60, immediate dedup, +100 no send, and expired bucket=-1 all passed. The pure boundary test proves every 30/14/7/1/0 value currently maps incorrectly to 60. Admin state was restored to commission expiry 2026-09-14 with alerts enabled.
rca_of_the_issue: Primary alert RCA: _current_alert_bucket returns the first bucket satisfying days_left <= b while ALERT_BUCKETS is ordered largest-to-smallest, so 60 wins for all 0..60 values. Mobile RCA: Layout.jsx permanently renders a fixed w-64 sidebar and ml-64 main area with no responsive breakpoint, producing 711px document width on a 390px viewport. Auth RCAs remain the unstable reverse-proxy host used in the lockout key and hardcoded wildcard/no-credentials CORS middleware.
